Maison

An atelier of restraint.

Founded in 2016, AVQENO is a curation of objects, garments and atmospheres made by artisans who refuse to compromise. Each piece is selected by our editors, made in limited runs, and built to outlive trend cycles.

We believe luxury is no longer ornament. It is silence, weight, and the texture of natural fibres against skin.
